_about: Read by scripts/onboard.sh and scripts/verify-device.sh. The first profile whose match fits wins. Only what was tested on a real device says status tested. Add a profile, or a model under models, when a new device has been through the whole flow; docs/LESSONS.md says why each quirk is here.

profiles.label: Fire OS 5 or 6 (Android 5 to 7)
profiles.mechanism: FireKeeper (usage stats and the log); install.sh picks the guard build itself

debloat.why: Fire OS 5 refuses disable-user; tools/fire-reapply.sh knows each model

quirks: Amazon's launcher stays enabled; FireKeeper sends Home to the front.
After a Fire OS update run android/tools/fire-reapply.sh.

profiles.label: Fire OS 7 or 8 (Android 9 and newer)
profiles.mechanism: Home Guard (accessibility service); Amazon keeps the HOME role

debloat.why: disable-user works; lists are per model

profiles.status: tested on AFTKM, Fire OS 8.1.8.6; Fire OS 7 not tested
quirks: ACTION_SETTINGS goes through Amazon's home activity, which Home Guard brings Home back from; Home opens MainSettingsActivity by component instead.
Home pressed while Amazon's own home is in front has no signal on Fire OS 8 (no homekey broadcast, no key filter): not solved. Check a reboot too.
Liquid glass needs Android 13; these are Android 9 to 11, so frost with a lit edge.
com.amazon.tv.csapp and com.amazon.ftvads.deeplinking refuse disable-user (protected).

profiles.label: TCL Android TV
profiles.mechanism: HOME role; install.sh switches to the guard build if the firmware refuses a launcher

debloat.why: earlier TCL results are under review: read docs/CLEANYOURTV-REVIEW.md, then decide with the owner

quirks: System text size ships at 1.0, so canvasFontScale reads TCL against 1.0 (Home's type was sized at 0.85). Another TCL model that ships at 0.85 would come out too small: check font_scale.
TCL's package verifier can block ADB installs; install.sh falls back to TCL's own screen sharing, with one confirmation on the TV.
com.tcl.appstatecontroller re-enables apps from TCL's servers at boot.

profiles.label: Hisense Android TV
profiles.mechanism: Home is not installed on this model

debloat.why: disable-user and uninstall did not survive a reboot on the tested model, and the first batch broke input switching; those results are under review (docs/CLEANYOURTV-REVIEW.md)

profiles.status: tested on SmartTV 4K (Android TV 12): no lasting changes, nothing installed
quirks: Do not install Home or disable packages here without the owner's decision after reading docs/CLEANYOURTV-REVIEW.md.
com.hisense.tv.smartsense, com.vt.tv.smartsense(.ui) and the aiot packages are never disabled: that sent a related set to Android Recovery.
VIDAA firmware handles volume itself; an accessibility key filter silences it.

profiles.label: Google TV or Android TV (onn, SHIELD and similar)
profiles.mechanism: HOME role; Google TV can take it back after a reboot (see guides/debloat-android-google-tv.md)

debloat.why: onn and SHIELD results are under review: read docs/CLEANYOURTV-REVIEW.md first

profiles.status: tested on onn 4K Plus, onn 4K Streaming Box, SHIELD tube
quirks: Liquid glass needs Android 13 or newer.
System text size ships at 0.85, which Home's type was sized on.

profiles.label: Not seen before
profiles.mechanism: install.sh decides from what the firmware does

debloat.why: no tested list: use guides/debloat-*.md discovery, one batch at a time

quirks: Read the device's text size (font_scale) first: the type is sized at 0.85.
After the install, find out what Settings and Home do (verify-device.sh), then add a profile here.

tizen.label: Samsung Tizen
tizen.install: tizen/build.py then tizen/deploy.sh (Tizen Studio CLI, a 'home' security profile, Rosetta on Apple Silicon, Pillow and your own logos in logos/dark/)
tizen.owner_steps: On the TV: Apps, press 1 2 3 4 5, switch Developer Mode on, enter this computer's IP, restart the TV. Nothing here roots it.
quirks: An app cannot register the Home button on Tizen: Smart Hub opens first, then Home.
A TV with 1 GB RAM gets LEAN=1 (still wallpaper, no frost); an unknown model starts lean, and Full can be chosen in Control Center.
The 2017 engine is Chromium M47: no CSS variables, grid or unprefixed filter; build.py compiles them away.
Developer Mode leaves an unprotected port open on the network: turn it off when done and prove it with scripts/adb-closed.py <tv-ip> 26101.
tvshot.py opens Home in debug mode, which leaves a port open until Home restarts.

webos.label: LG webOS
webos.install: not automated: a rooted TV, then CleanYourTV as Home plus the files in webos/ (webos/README.md)
webos.owner_steps: Rooting is the owner's decision and cannot be taken back (SlopBro, Homebrew Channel). This project does not root TVs.
quirks: webOS does not let apps replace Home: it runs on CleanYourTV's Home takeover.
Installing LG's own Developer Mode app on a rooted TV breaks the root.
Blocking LG updates keeps the root and stops LG's security fixes.
